# dsh-AuthInOne > 在 DSH 原生模型与用量设置增加账号接入、模型切换和费用分析。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne) - **版本号**：0.2.0-alpha.4（[固定提交 190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/tree/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-16（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核对协调和刷新，真实 OAuth 完成与用量未复验。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：用户管理多种模型账号与 API Provider，需要集中查看。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 把账号状态与模型使用放进同一界面。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 精确 Host 依赖和提供商确认边界限制真实可用性。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 单 Provider 对照配置和核账工时。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先现有 API Provider，再单账号授权验收。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 把账号状态与模型使用放进同一界面。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 精确 Host 依赖和提供商确认边界限制真实可用性。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 单 Provider 对照配置和核账工时。 匹配构建验证登录、调用、刷新、退出及模型统计。 ## 场景与替代办法 用户管理多种模型账号与 API Provider，需要集中查看。 原生 API Provider 设置加单独账户与日志核对。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 精确兼容 DSH 构建 | 必需 | 注册原生页面及凭据 | 未知指纹拒绝引导安装 | | 提供商合法账号或 API | 按路径需要 | 调用模型 | 外部许可和配额独立 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 核对 Host 与测试 profile | 保存当前状态 | | 接入 | 单 Provider 授权或配置 | 分别验收调用 | | 核账 | 比较 Usage 与实际服务 | 缺价不推断账单 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 费用未知 | 匹配构建并配置账号 | 可能替换 Host | | 持续 | 调用费用未知 | 维护路由、协议和价格 | 逐提供商差异 | | 失败 | 恢复工时未知 | 恢复原 API 路由 | 核对退出和凭据状态 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 模型管理 | 集中状态、切换和使用量 | 真实账号调用及账单精度 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：DSH 用户能否在原生设置管理账号模型并核对使用量？ ### Q01 · 账号接入在何处变成模型选择？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 插件在原生 Models 与 Usage 中提供服务，登录协调器经历 starting、pending 和 connected，并保存 Host 凭据，再提供模型状态。它复用 DSH 的 Provider 和自定义兼容接口，新增账号流程与分析显示。作者实测只到用户确认边界，不能据此声称订阅调用已端到端完成。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:7-11](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/README.md#L7-L11) 范围及实测边界。 ```text dsh-AuthInOne is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for Provider login, API and custom OpenAI-compatible Provider setup, model switching, optional vision fallback for text-only models, token usage analytics, and cost tracking inside DSH's native **Models** and **Usage** settings. OpenAI Codex uses browser OAuth with state, S256 PKCE, and a loopback callback. Kimi Code opens the Provider's complete authorization link backed by an RFC 8628 device flow; the link carries the short code, so the user normally only signs in and confirms. xAI Grok, Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Command Code, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and Kiro are explicitly marked **Experimental compatibility**. Installed-Host validation reached each Provider's authorization boundary and stopped before user consent; mock/fixture tests cover exchange or polling, refresh rotation, denial, timeout, cancellation, logout, route activation, and secret redaction. > **Alpha `v0.2.0-alpha.4`** · exact compatibility target: official DSH `47f9438` · the self-contained bootstrap uses the official DSH plugin CLI and returns Web on its original port · [release notes](docs/releases/v0.2.0-alpha.4.md) · MIT · community-maintained and not a DeepSeek or OpenAI product. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/host/auth.ts:202-250](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/src/host/auth.ts#L202-L250) 登录状态与凭据成功路径。
查看原文（49行） ```text if (this.state.status === 'connected') return this.snapshot() if (this.attempt !== undefined) return this.snapshot() const attempt: PendingAttempt = { id: randomUUID(), controller: new AbortController(), cancelled: false } this.attempt = attempt this.state = this.view('starting', { attemptId: attempt.id }) let resolveReady!: (view: AuthProviderView) => void let rejectReady!: (error: unknown) => void let readySettled = false const ready = new Promise((resolve, reject) => { resolveReady = resolve rejectReady = reject }) void this.engine.login(attempt.controller.signal, ready => { if (this.attempt !== attempt) return this.state = this.view('pending', { authorizationUrl: ready.authorizationUrl, verificationUrl: ready.verificationUrl ?? null, userCode: ready.userCode ?? null, inputPrompt: ready.inputPrompt === undefined ? null : { kind: ready.inputPrompt.kind, label: ready.inputPrompt.label, placeholder: ready.inputPrompt.placeholder ?? null, }, attemptId: attempt.id, expiresAt: ready.expiresAt, }) if (!readySettled) { readySettled = true resolveReady(this.snapshot()) } }).then(accountLabel => { if (this.attempt !== attempt) return this.attempt = undefined if (attempt.cancelled) return this.onConnected() this.state = this.view('connected', { accountLabel }) if (!readySettled) { readySettled = true resolveReady(this.snapshot()) } }, error => { if (this.attempt !== attempt) return this.attempt = undefined const failure = this.failure(error) const status = attempt.cancelled || failure.category === 'cancelled' ? 'cancelled' : failure.category === 'expired' ? 'expired' : 'error' this.state = this.view(status, { errorCategory: failure.category, error: failure.message }) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/host/index.ts:275-304](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/src/host/index.ts#L275-L304) 模型状态入口。
查看原文（30行） ```text /** Read provider routes, connection state, models, and the future-Agent default. */ @Remote('providers') async providers(): Promise { await this.authReady await Promise.all(this.authRuntimes.map(runtime => runtime.coordinator.synchronize())) const active = new Map(this.ctx.llm.listProviders().map(provider => [provider.id, provider])) const configurable = new Map(this.ctx.llm.listConfigurableProviders().map(provider => [provider.provider, provider])) const authInstances = this.authRuntimes .map(runtime => runtime.coordinator.snapshot()) .filter(auth => isAuthProviderInstance(auth.status)) const ids = [...new Set([ ...configurable.keys(), ...active.keys(), ...authInstances.map(auth => auth.id), ])] const descriptors = this.descriptors() const candidates = await Promise.all(ids.map(async (id): Promise => { const live = active.get(id) const entry = configurable.get(id) const descriptor = entry === undefined ? undefined : descriptors.get(entry.settingsNs) const profile = entry === undefined ? undefined : getPath(descriptor?.value, entry.settingsPath) const runtime = this.authRuntime(id) const authCatalog = runtime?.coordinator.snapshot() const auth = authCatalog !== undefined && isAuthProviderInstance(authCatalog.status) ? authCatalog : undefined if (!shouldProjectProviderConnection({ provider: id, hasLiveRoute: live !== undefined, hasProfile: profile !== undefined, authStatus: auth?.status ?? null, })) return null ```
#### 缺口 - 当前真实账号授权与模型输出未知 **影响**：无法保证提供商政策和订阅可用 **进一步探讨**：用户授权下单独验收 consent、模型调用与刷新 ### Q02 · 凭据刷新和兼容绑定如何限制采用？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 凭据存储将同一 Provider 的 refreshFlight 合并，观察到拒绝会要求重新授权。按 generation 处理竞争，但这只覆盖同服务实例，跨 Host 还需验收。固定候选要求精确官方构建，bootstrap 会校验 Host 并替换同端口服务。实验兼容渠道必须分别验证提供商允许的调用和撤销。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/host/auth-store.ts:55-65](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/src/host/auth-store.ts#L55-L65) 实例级刷新控制。

OPENAI_CODEX_CREDENTIAL_REF : credentialRef(name) } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/host/auth-store.ts:97-132](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/src/host/auth-store.ts#L97-L132) 刷新、拒绝和 single flight。
查看原文（36行） ```text /** Return a fresh access token, rotating the stored refresh token at most once per generation. */ async accessToken(adapter: AuthProviderAdapter, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise { const current = await this.read() if (current === undefined || current.needsReauth === true) throw new AuthProtocolError('refresh-rejected') if (current.expiresAt > Date.now() + REFRESH_EARLY_MS) return current.accessToken if (this.refreshFlight !== undefined) return (await this.refreshFlight).accessToken const startedGeneration = credentialGeneration(current) const refresh = (async (): Promise => { let fresh: StoredOAuthCredential try { fresh = await adapter.refresh(current, signal) } catch (error) { if (error instanceof AuthProtocolError && error.category === 'refresh-rejected') { await this.enqueue(async () => { const stored = await this.read() if (stored === undefined || credentialGeneration(stored) !== startedGeneration) return await this.ctx.credentials.set(this.ref, JSON.stringify({ ...stored, needsReauth: true })) }) } throw error } return this.enqueue(async () => { const stored = await this.read() if (stored === undefined) throw new AuthProtocolError('cancelled') if (credentialGeneration(stored) !== startedGeneration) { if (stored.needsReauth !== true && stored.expiresAt > Date.now() + REFRESH_EARLY_MS) return stored throw new AuthProtocolError('refresh-rejected') } await this.ctx.credentials.set(this.ref, JSON.stringify(fresh)) return fresh }) })().finally(() => { if (this.refreshFlight === refresh) this.refreshFlight = undefined }) this.refreshFlight = refresh return (await refresh).accessToken ```

The install command returns before the old Host stops; the browser may disconnect briefly, then the same URL must return. ```` #### 缺口 - 真实凭据轮转和多进程未测 **影响**：无法保证竞争刷新或第三方协议长期成立 **进一步探讨**：隔离授权测试并发刷新、拒绝、取消与注销 ### Q03 · 怎样先测账号面板的实际价值？ **研究主题**：采用判断、效果与总成本、新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 先在匹配 Host 的测试 profile 使用现有 API Provider 查看状态和 Usage，比较手工设置和日志统计。账号流程在用户授权后单渠道验收登录、调用、刷新和退出。若只有到达授权页、费用缺价或路由不稳定，就维持原生 Provider 与账单核对。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:25-31](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/README.md#L25-L31) 具体采用场景。 ```text ## Use this plugin when - you want OpenAI Codex or Kimi Code login inside DSH, or knowingly opt into a labeled compatibility flow; - you manage API-key or custom OpenAI-compatible Providers in DSH's native Models page; - you switch the future-session default model without replacing DSH's per-session selector; - you want a separately configured vision model to describe images only when the selected main model explicitly declares text-only input; - you need reconstructable Provider/model/tool token usage and auditable calculated cost. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:43-52](https://github.com/Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne/blob/190ecc2d834ba06da008522684e689324a9c2706/README.md#L43-L52) 原生、真实与 fixture 分列。
